spanish: Y su carne será a ti; como pecho del balanceo y como pierna de la derecha a ti será.

findings.issue: The first ל suffix is 2fs and the second is 2ms; both are gender-neutral a ti, so the feminine is not shown and both read as the same tú. Person and number stay 2sg.
balanceo is an uncertain match for H8573; it can mean rocking or equilibrating, not only a to-and-fro wave.
Definite construct חזה התנופה is bare pecho del balanceo; both nouns are present and the article on the waving is kept, but the head noun is not marked definite.
Definite construct שוק הימין is bare pierna de la derecha; both nouns are present and the article on the right side is kept, but the head noun is not marked definite.

notes: Y, singular carne with 3mp su, both qal será, and como twice match the tokens.
